description: Fetch structures with metadata and coordinate-file URLs. source "experimental" takes PDB entry IDs, and also resolves the computed-model IDs protein_search_structures returns (AF_*/MA_*), which come back marked source "predicted" with their modelling provider; "predicted" takes UniProt accessions, isoform accessions (P04637-2), or AlphaFold DB entry IDs (AF-P04637-2-F1) (AlphaFold, with pLDDT/PAE confidence); "best_available" takes the same identifiers, an entry ID reduced to its accession, and returns the top federated model — the PDB entry with the widest UniProt coverage, ties going to the finest resolution (coverage measures the mapped span, so the pick can be an engineered mutant over the wild-type entry), else the model with the highest confidence on the lDDT scale (pLDDT/100 or QMEANDisCo), unscored models last, which can include an experimental model outside the PDB such as a SASBDB fit; best_available records carry coverage and the UniProt span. Under predicted and best_available, a UniProt accession merged into another entry resolves to its successor's model with a notice naming the merge, and a demerged or deleted accession lands in failed[] with its replacements. Records fetched under source "experimental", computed models included, also carry polymer entities with both chain namespaces (labelAsymIds for protein_compare_structures, authAsymIds for protein_get_annotations), bound ligands, molecular weight, and release date. Resolves up to the configured batch cap per call with per-ID partial success: IDs are trimmed and repeats looked up once, missed IDs are listed in failed[] with their reasons, and IDs beyond the cap are listed in ignored, never looked up. Upstream lookups share one time budget per call; under predicted and best_available, an ID not finished within it, or whose upstream lookup failed, lands in failed[] with a reason to re-call it. Set include_coords to inline coordinate text, held to 24000 characters per response on both surfaces: a lone selected file arrives in 24000-character windows, each giving coordinatesNextOffset to pass back as coords_offset; several selected files inline whole when they total 24000 characters or fewer, and otherwise overflow lists each file's length — re-call with sections naming one structure to page through its file. coordinateUrls always link the complete files.

coords_offset.description: Character offset of the window to return when exactly one structure is selected (sections naming one ID, or include_coords on a one-ID call): the window is characters [coords_offset, coords_offset + 24000). Pass the coordinatesNextOffset a previous window returned.

ids.description: PDB entry IDs or computed-model IDs such as AF_AFP69905F1 (source experimental); UniProt accessions, isoform accessions such as P04637-2, or AlphaFold DB entry IDs such as AF-P04637-2-F1 (predicted / best_available). Trimmed, and a repeat (case-insensitive) is looked up once.

include_coords.description: Inline coordinate text for every resolved structure — mmCIF, or PDB format when no mmCIF URL is available; coordinateFormat names which. A lone file arrives in 24000-character windows. Off by default — URLs are always returned.

sections.description: Structure IDs to inline coordinates for, in place of include_coords — from an overflow outline, or one ID to page through its file with coords_offset. Each must match the id of a structure this call resolves.

source.description: Where to fetch: experimental (PDB), predicted (AlphaFold), or best_available (federated pick).

name: protein_get_structure

attribution.description: Upstream data-source licenses and citations for every source present in structures[] — RCSB PDB for PDB entries, the providing database (AlphaFold DB, ModelArchive, SWISS-MODEL, SASBDB, …) for any other model. Always present — the attribution obligation travels with the data.

items.description: Upstream data-source attribution: license, citation, and homepage.

citation.description: Primary-literature citation to credit the source.

license.description: License the source data is released under (e.g. "CC BY 4.0").

source.description: Contributing data-source display name (e.g. "RCSB PDB", "AlphaFold DB", "SWISS-MODEL", "UniProt"). Open-ended — best_available structures are federated through 3D-Beacons providers.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `mixed_id_types`: The batch mixes PDB IDs and UniProt accessions under a single source that cannot serve both. `all_failed`: No processed ID resolved to a structure, and at least one has none: no record, a malformed ID, or an inactive or unknown accession. data.failed carries each ID with its reason. `upstream_unavailable`: Under predicted or best_available, no processed ID resolved and none is known to lack a structure: each ID's upstream lookup failed (an error status, an HTML page, a network failure, or a request timeout) or ran out of the call's time budget. data.failed carries each ID with its reason. `coords_offset_needs_one_structure`: coords_offset is above 0 while the call selects no structure, or several, for inlined coordinates. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

failed.description: IDs that could not be resolved (partial success).

items.description: A requested ID that did not resolve, with the reason.

ignored.description: IDs past the batch cap, never looked up — trimmed, repeats dropped, in input order. Pass them as ids in a follow-up call with the same source. Absent when the cap dropped nothing.

notice.description: Every applicable advisory joined into one string: repeated IDs counted once, batch cap, partial failures, a UniProt merge that resolved an accession to its successor, an unavailable PDB check behind a best_available pick, a computed model whose provider coordinate lookup failed (only its BinaryCIF URL listed), the re-call for the next coordinate window, a coords_offset past the end of the file, a sections entry that matched no structure, coordinate-budget overflow, and failed coordinate inlining.

overflow.description: Present only when two or more selected coordinate files together exceed 24000 characters, the budget for one response; their coordinates are then withheld from both surfaces.

notice.description: How to page through one structure's coordinates with sections and coords_offset.

sections.description: Per-structure coordinate file lengths, for a targeted re-call.

items.description: A withheld structure and its coordinate file length.

bytes.description: Length of the structure's coordinate file in characters, the unit coords_offset counts.

id.description: Structure ID whose coordinates were withheld.

processed.description: Number of distinct IDs looked up: a repeated ID counts once, and IDs past the batch cap are listed in ignored instead.

requested.description: Number of IDs in the original request, repeats included, before de-duplication and the batch cap.

resolved.description: Number of processed IDs that resolved to a structure.

items.description: A resolved structure with metadata and coordinate-file URLs.

confidence.description: Model confidence on its native scale; confidenceType names the metric and range (e.g. pLDDT 0–100, QMEANDisCo 0–1). Present for predicted models that report a score.

confidenceType.description: Name of the confidence metric carried in confidence (e.g. "pLDDT", "QMEANDisCo"). Providers score on different scales; this names the one in use.

coordinateFormat.description: Format of inlined coordinates, when present.

coordinateUrls.description: Coordinate file download URLs. A format with no published file is omitted — e.g. pdb for large entries archived as mmCIF only.

coordinates.description: Inlined coordinate text: characters [coordinatesOffset, coordinatesOffset + its length) of the file coordinateFormat names. A lone selected file arrives in windows of up to 24000 characters; several selected files arrive whole only when they total 24000 characters or fewer.

coordinatesNextOffset.description: Offset of the next window when the file continues past coordinates — pass it as coords_offset with sections naming this structure. Absent when coordinates reaches the end of the file.

coordinatesOffset.description: Character offset in the coordinate file where coordinates begins. Present whenever coordinates is.

coverage.description: Fraction (0–1) of the UniProt sequence the best_available pick's mapped span covers — the span between uniprotStart and uniprotEnd, which can include residues the model leaves unmodeled. Present only under source best_available.

id.description: Structure identifier: the PDB entry ID, or the UniProt accession the model belongs to — isoform suffix kept, the accession an AlphaFold DB entry ID names, or the successor when UniProt merged the requested accession (the notice names the merge).

ligands.description: Bound non-polymer components. Present when the call used source experimental; omitted under source predicted or best_available, when the entry binds none, or when the record carries no ligand data.

meanPlddt.description: Mean pLDDT confidence (0–100); present only for pLDDT-scored models. For other metrics read confidence + confidenceType.

molecularWeight.description: Deposited structure molecular weight in kDa. Present only when the call used source experimental; omitted when the record does not report one.

organisms.description: Source organisms: under source experimental, every distinct source organism of the entry, in entity-number order; under source predicted, the AlphaFold DB model's organism. Omitted when upstream names none, and on best_available records.

pdbId.description: Chosen PDB entry ID when a best_available query resolved to a PDB entry (id stays the queried UniProt accession), so the structure can be cited without parsing the coordinate URL. Absent for any other pick, including an experimental model outside the PDB such as a SASBDB fit.

polymerEntities.description: Modeled polymer entities, each with both chain namespaces — authAsymIds for protein_get_annotations.chain, labelAsymIds for protein_compare_structures.chain. Present when the call used source experimental (computed-model IDs included); omitted under source predicted or best_available and for entries with none.

items.description: A modeled polymer entity (chain group), with both chain namespaces.

authAsymIds.description: Author-assigned chain IDs (auth_asym_id, e.g. ["A","C"]) — the namespace protein_get_annotations.chain takes. Omitted when upstream does not report them.

labelAsymIds.description: mmCIF label_asym_id chain IDs (e.g. ["I","OB"]) — the namespace protein_compare_structures.chain takes. Not derivable from authAsymIds: for 6QNR_9 the label chains are I/OB against author chains 82/8E. Omitted when upstream does not report them.

organisms.description: Distinct source organisms of this entity — more than one for a chimera (2RH1_1: Homo sapiens, Tequatrovirus T4). Omitted when upstream names none.

sequenceLength.description: Residue count of the sample sequence.

provider.description: Model provider: the modelling provider of a predicted record, or the federated provider of a best_available pick (PDBe for a PDB entry).

releaseDate.description: Initial release date (ISO 8601). Present only when the call used source experimental; omitted when the record does not report one.

source.description: Whether the structure is experimental or predicted.

uniprotEnd.description: Last UniProt residue of the best_available pick's mapped span. Present only under source best_available.

uniprotStart.description: First UniProt residue of the best_available pick's mapped span. Present only under source best_available.

title: protein-mcp-server: get structure
